entities.description: A male soldier with a beard stands in profile facing left, wearing a full set of military tactical gear including a tan helmet with a mounted scope, a tan plate carrier over a camouflage uniform, and tan combat boots. He holds two black pistols, one in each hand, with a watch visible on his left wrist, set against a blurred background of a rocky riverbed and mountains.

clothing.helmet: tan tactical helmet with scope mount
clothing.vest: tan tactical plate carrier with pouches

entities.description: A bearded man of South Asian descent stands in profile facing right, wearing a black turban and a long brown wool overcoat over a matching shirt and trousers. He holds a wooden-stocked rifle vertically by his side with his right hand, standing on a rocky riverbed with a blurred mountainous background.

A man with a medium complexion and dark hair stands facing forward, wearing a tan military-style uniform consisting of a long-sleeved button-up shirt with shoulder epaulets and chest pockets, matching trousers, and a brown leather belt with a gold buckle. He wears a traditional tan turban and dark combat boots, with a serious expression, set against a blurred background of a river and mountains.

clothing.shirt: tan long-sleeved uniform shirt with epaulets and pockets
